identity_evidence.verdict: Moneybag is COINED. The cartridge's class name is daGmch_c. The name is allowed under the current rule but must never be presented as ROM-proven; this field is that record.
identity_evidence.rom_string: extracted/overlays/overlay_0081.bin, file offset 0x5488 -> address 0x02128bc8, bytes 38 64 61 47 6d 63 68 5f 63 00 = "8daGmch_c\0". That is the Itanium length-prefixed _ZTS form: length 8, then the 8 characters d a G m c h _ c. Address = 0x02123740 + file offset, with no adjustment (see module_base).
identity_evidence.negative_search: SEARCH CASE, SCOPE AND ENCODING, stated explicitly because a negative claim is worthless without them. Encoding: raw ASCII byte substring. Case: CASE-FOLDED -- both the haystack and the needle were lowercased before matching, so this search cannot be defeated by capitalisation the way a previous scout's was. Scope: 106 code images (extracted/arm9.bin, extracted/arm9_dec.bin, extracted/arm7.bin and all 103 extracted/overlays/overlay_*.bin) PLUS 2,073 files of the unpacked ROM filesystem under extracted/dsd/files/. Results: b'moneybag' -> 0 hits in the 106 code images and 0 hits in the 2,073 filesystem files. b'8moneybag' (the length-prefixed _ZTS form a Moneybag TU would emit) -> 0 hits in both scopes. So nothing in this cartridge spells Moneybag in any case, in code or in data.
identity_evidence.what_the_cartridge_does_call_it: b'gamaguchi' case-folded -> 11 hits in the code images and 10 in the filesystem. The profile name string "GAMAGUCHI" sits at arm9_dec.bin file offset 0x8bee8 = address 0x0208fee8, and extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin carries the asset paths data/enemy/gamaguchi/gamaguchi.bmd and .../gamaguchi_jump.bca. Gamaguchi is a clasp-purse, so the English sense of the coined name is right; what is absent is any C++ identity spelling it.
identity_evidence.false_positive_warning: b'gmch' case-folded also hits extracted/dsd/files/data/stage/fire_mt/fire_mt_icg.bin at 0x4024 inside the byte run 'HCGMCHBF'. That is unrelated binary data, exactly the class of substring false positive PIPELINE.md warns about (Koopa/Door/Coin/Key/Fish). The only meaningful hit for b'8dagmch_c' is the single ov081 one above.
identity_evidence.whole_overlay_string_census: The entire 0x5620-byte ov081 image contains exactly FIVE printable runs of >=5 characters, and all five are _ZTS records: 8daHuwa_c (0x02128840), 11daSnowman_c (0x021289bc), 12daSnowball_c (0x02128a88), 8daGmch_c (0x02128bc8), 15daObjIceBlock_c (0x02128c8c). There is no room in this overlay for a hidden English class name.
identity_evidence.tooling_corroboration: tools/rtti_extract.py at this base wrote build/rtti.json with 429 records, 413 edges, 0 unresolved. Its record for this class is {module: ov081, addr: 0x02128bd4, kind: si, mangled: 8daGmch_c, name: daGmch_c, name_addr: 0x02128bc8, vtable: 0x02128c04, vtable_module: ov081}. `tools/rtti_vtables.py --own daGmch_c` prints the 10-slot override set below; `tools/rtti_vtables.py --own Moneybag` prints 'no vtable for Moneybag' -- the ROM-derived database has never heard the name.
identity_evidence.registry_corroboration: symbols/profile_reconstruction_registry.json, entry actor_id 261, states class_name daGmch_c with class_name_source 'SM64DS RTTI ov081:0x02128bd4'. Per the project's own finding that registry class_name IS real RTTI, this is an independent second attestation of the same string, and it agrees.
identity_evidence.symbols_txt_asymmetry: config/arm9/overlays/ov081/symbols.txt aliases the VTABLE under BOTH spellings at one address (_ZTV8Moneybag and _ZTV8daGmch_c, both addr:0x02128c04) but names _ZTS and _ZTI under the daGmch_c spelling ONLY (_ZTS8daGmch_c 0x02128bc8, _ZTI8daGmch_c 0x02128bd4). A TU compiled as `class Moneybag` therefore emits _ZTS8Moneybag and _ZTI8Moneybag, neither of which has any home in the cartridge.
identity_evidence.length_coincidence_hazard: READ THIS BEFORE CONSIDERING INTACT-OBJECT. 'Moneybag' and 'daGmch_c' are BOTH 8 characters, so both mangle to a length-8 prefix and both _ZTS payloads are exactly 10 bytes ('8Moneybag\0' vs '8daGmch_c\0'). The wrong name would therefore produce RTTI of the CORRECT SIZE and the WRONG CONTENT -- a silent byte mismatch that no size or extent check catches. This is survivable on the queue's declared text-only route, where the RTTI data is externalized and never emitted, and it is FATAL and hard to diagnose on an intact-object route. Do not attempt intact-object under the coined spelling.
identity_evidence.sibling_naming_pattern: All FIVE classes in ov081 carry coined English tree names aliased onto the ROM name, in the same shape: daHuwa_c=Spindrift (0x0212887c), daSnowman_c=MrBlizzard (0x021289f0), daSnowball_c=Snowball (0x02128abc), daGmch_c=Moneybag (0x02128c04), daObjIceBlock_c=IceBlock (0x02128cc4). Not one of ov081's classes is spelt with its ROM name in the tree.

pointer_to_member_records.alignment_proof: The alignment phase is proven, not assumed -- the 4-byte-off trap would have yielded zero valid records here. Two independent confirmations: (a) reading at 8-byte stride from 0x02128b38 gives 18 records whose even word is always a code address inside this class's text run and whose odd word is always 0; (b) config/arm9/overlays/ov081/relocs.txt carries kind:load records at exactly 0x02128b38, b40, b48, ... bc0 -- 18 rows at 8-byte stride, module overlay(81) -- and NO relocation at any of the intervening +4 addresses, which is only consistent with this phase. pointer_to_member_records.state_table_layout: The 18 records are NINE states of TWO handlers each (16 bytes per state). Proven by the setter's `add r1, r2, r1, lsl #4` (stride 16) together with the two invokers: 0x02127744 reads [r3] and 0x02127708 reads [r3+8]. State N occupies 0x02128f40 + N*16.

pointer_to_member_records.WRITER_HAZARD: These 18 records live in UNOWNED .data (see delinks_ownership) and dsd resolves them BY SYMBOL NAME. If any of these 18 members is renamed to a mangled _ZN8Moneybag... name, that new name MUST reach config/arm9/overlays/ov081/symbols.txt in the SAME commit, or every one of these records links as 0x00000000 and the state machine dispatches to null. tree_derived.promoted_siblings_in_ov081: None of Spindrift, MrBlizzard, Snowball or IceBlock is promoted at this base.
tree_derived.delinks_ownership: config/arm9/overlays/ov081/delinks.txt has 113 file blocks and EVERY ONE of them is .text or .init only. No delink file owns any .data, .rodata, .ctor or .bss. So the vtable, the RTTI records, the profile, the 18 PMF records and all 13 .bss objects stay in the unowned/unlicensed block after promotion -- the promoted TU will not own its own vtable, which is the expected shape for the text-only route.

blockers_for_the_writer: PMF NAME COUPLING (the real one). 18 of the 26 auto-named members are reachable ONLY through pointer-to-member records in unowned .data, which dsd resolves by symbol NAME. Renaming any of those 18 is one edit, not two: the mangled name must land in config/arm9/overlays/ov081/symbols.txt in the same commit or the record links as 0. No stage-2 or stage-3 byte gate detects it.

THE CEILING IS NAME RECOVERY, NOT CODEGEN. All 26 unconverted members carry auto-generated func_ov081_* names; only the 10 vtable overrides already carry mangled names. This is the ov071/Scuttlebug wall, not the dScMgCurling2_c one. A realistic conversion target is 10/36 for free, and anything beyond that is a coordinated naming pass. The 9-state x 2-handler table recovered above is the evidence base for naming the 18.

COINED NAME + LENGTH COINCIDENCE. 'Moneybag' and 'daGmch_c' are both 8 characters, so a wrongly-named TU emits _ZTS/_ZTI of exactly the right SIZE and the wrong CONTENT. Fine on the declared text-only route; silently fatal on intact-object.
A member function cannot sit inside an extern "C" { } region, so the one file-scope region must go after the last surviving func_* member.
not_blockers: No cross-module caller has to move: there are zero cross-module calls into the text run.
No sibling class calls into the run, so the 0x02126504..0x02127b34 slice is clean.
The header already exists and already asserts the right size; most likely no header edit is needed.
No vague-linkage split: _ZTV, _ZTI and _ZTS are all in ov081.
unproven: The class name 'Moneybag' itself. It is COINED. The cartridge says daGmch_c and nothing in any of the 106 code images or 2,073 filesystem files spells 'moneybag' in any case. Recorded as coined per PIPELINE.md; do NOT run class_rename.py to manufacture agreement.

'g_profile_GAMAGUCHI' as a SYMBOL NAME is reconstructed. The ROM proves the string GAMAGUCHI at 0x0208fee8 and proves a 0x1c descriptor at 0x02128be0 whose first word is the factory, but the C identifier spelling is the project's, not the cartridge's.

'daGmch_c_classInit' as a FUNCTION NAME is reconstructed. The address, the shape and the class are proven; the word classInit comes from later EAD lineage, not from this cartridge. Its historical alias in the tree is Moneybag_Spawn.

The role of 6 of the 8 file-local helpers (0x021265c8, 0x02126700, 0x02126758, 0x02126950, 0x02126a20). Their call counts and callers are proven; what they DO is not, and no name should be invented for them without reading the bodies.
Semantic names for all 18 state-machine members. The state INDEX and the enter/update half of each is proven from the initializer; the meaning of each state is not.
What state index 0..8 each MEAN. Only the table order is proven.
Field TYPES at 0x3e0 and 0x3e4. Both are word-sized and 0x3e4 is compared signed; neither type nor meaning is proven.
Field meanings at 0x3f1 and 0x3f2. Proven to be LIVE byte fields (ldrb/strb), not padding; nothing more.

The existing header's names mMatrix, mSpawnPosX/Y/Z and mState. The offsets and sizes are corroborated by the displacements measured here, but the names are the tree's prior reconstruction, not ROM-proven.
Whether the 4-word .rodata pointer table at 0x021280d8 should be owned by the promoted TU. It points only into this class's .bss, but no delink file owns .rodata today.
